newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield at Indian 91-day t-bill at 6.60 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield at Indian 91-day t-bill at 6.60 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it maintained a cut-off rate of 98.38 rupees at its auction of 91-day treasury bills on Thursday.
Dealers said the yield was unchanged at 6.60 percent.

RBI said it received 9 competitive bids for 3.65 billion rupees, and one non-competitive bid for 500 million rupees. Of these four competitive bids (3 partial) were accepted, to an amount of 2.62 billion rupees, along with one non-competitive bid (partial allotment) amounting to 384.625 million rupees.
The percentage of partial allotment worked out to 76.92 percent. There was no devolvement on RBI or on the primary dealers. The weighted average cut-off was 98.38 rupees.
